views.markdown: **ADBiOS** empowers power-users to manage, tweak, and debug their Android devices straight from iOS using a sleek, native interface. Control, shell, and manage files on your Android device over ADB!

### 📊 Dashboard Redesign
- **System Overview**: Clean visual interface showing real-time stats for connected Android devices.
- **Hardware Status**: Live progress bars for battery capacity and storage usage.
- **Network & Radios**: One-glance status for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and essential radios.

### 📂 Enhanced File Explorer (ES Explorer Style)
- **Visual Redesign**: Inspired by classic Android file managers like ES File Explorer.
- **Path Breadcrumbs**: Sticky header breadcrumbs for easy filesystem navigation.
- **Smart Parsing & Fallbacks**: Provides raw fallback views when directories fail standard parsing.

### 📱 Advanced App Management (Root & Non-Root)
- **Standard Actions**: Launch, force stop, clear data, uninstall.
- **Root Actions**: Freeze/unfreeze, enable/disable system apps, deep clear data (`su -c pm clear`), system app debloating.

### 🖥️ Root Terminal & Shell Macros
- **Interactive Shell**: Interactive terminal with categorized visual macros.
- **Root Command List**: Quick root-only commands like `setenforce 0`, `reboot bootloader`, and system service restarts.

- **Install**: Download `com.nanerasingh.adbios_1.0_iphoneos-arm64.deb` and install via Sileo or Zebra.
- **Environment**: Built for modern rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine / Palera1n).
- **ADB Setup**: Ensure target Android device has Wireless Debugging enabled or is connected on port 5555.
